extra.final_summary: Found and fixed three issues: (1) species labels had case variants and a misspelling ('Gentto'), which were normalized to the allowed labels. (2) Two flipper_length_mm values were negative (-190, -195), which are impossible per the rules (valid range: 170-235 mm); these rows were excluded. (3) body_mass_g was stored as text with commas; it was cast to numeric. After these fixes, the average flipper length per species is: Adelie: 193.17 mm, Chinstrap: 196.92 mm, Gentoo: 216.68 mm.
